chunks.content: The recommended starting dose of FIXTORVAN is 10 mg or 20 mg once daily. The dose range is 10 mg to 80 mg once daily.

FIXTORVAN may cause myopathy and rhabdomyolysis. Acute kidney injury secondary to myoglobinuria has occurred. Risk factors include age 65 years or greater, uncontrolled hypothyroidism and renal impairment.
Acute liver failure or decompensated cirrhosis. Hypersensitivity to fixtorvastatin.
Store at 20 to 25 degrees C (68 to 77 degrees F). Keep the bottle tightly closed.
The recommended dose of FIXABAN is 5 mg taken orally twice daily.

In patients with at least two of the following characteristics: age 80 years or older, body weight 60 kg or less, or serum creatinine 1.5 mg/dL or greater, the recommended dose of FIXABAN is 2.5 mg twice daily.
Premature discontinuation of any oral anticoagulant, including FIXABAN, increases the risk of thrombotic events.
Women should be advised not to breastfeed during treatment with FIXABAN.
